title: Trash
intro: Deleted objects you currently own, including those inherited from a shared Owner scope. Nothing here is permanently erased.
emptyTypeTitle: No recoverable objects of this type
emptyDescription: Objects appear here only when your current access allows recovery. Removed context links are listed separately inside each Event.
emptyTypeDescription: Try all types. Only objects you can currently recover are shown.
recovered: Recovered as version {version}. Normal views have been refreshed.
keepsNote: Recovery keeps this object's ID, current content, files, permissions, and history. It creates a new version, without replaying an earlier snapshot.
linksNote: Existing links appear again only when both objects are available and authorized. Independently removed links stay removed. Related objects are not recovered automatically.
grantsNote: Recovery does not re-create revoked grants. Inherited access must be managed on its canonical scope.
